explication: Abogen converts books and other text sources into spoken audio with synchronized subtitles. Users submit work through either the desktop GUI or the feature-richer Web UI; inputs are extracted, prepared for conversion, synthesized by a selected TTS backend, and written as audio and subtitle outputs. The repository also supports chapter and speaker/entity workflows, plugin-based engines, LLM normalization, and Audiobookshelf/Calibre integrations. The graph combines README capabilities with the sampled source; links for unsampled subsystems are limited to documented or evident entry points.
